title: Symmetric DNA Gene Segment
description: You are analyzing a string representing a genetic sequence. You need to find the longest continuous segment of the gene sequence that reads the same forwards and backwards (a palindromic gene segment). Return this maximum length substring.
constraints: gene consists of only digits and English letters.
output_format: A string representing the longest palindromic substring.

examples.explanation: The longest symmetric gene block is "bb".
A single character is always a valid palindrome.
